methods.name: events
methods.description: Events from every calendar (or one account), soonest first: `days` from `date` (default today, 1 day; up to 62), optional search on title, place and notes. Times are local; `day` is today/tomorrow/weekday. {events: [{title, calendar, account, start, end, day, all_day, location, description, meeting_url, meeting}], errors?}; meeting is the video service (Teams, Zoom, Google Meet…) when the event has a join link.

account.description: An account from calendar.calendars (provider:name, e.g. caldav:ik); omitted: every account.

methods.name: calendars
methods.description: The user's calendars across providers: account (provider:name), calendar name, whether events can be added.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Add an event: title, start (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM local), minutes (default 60), optional location; account (provider:name) and calendar name pick where.

account.description: An account from calendar.calendars (provider:name, e.g. caldav:ik); omitted: every account.
